summary: Lets CoAP clients and intermediaries avoid keeping per-request state, by introducing an optional extension for longer token lengths. The extra space lets the needed state be carried in the token itself. It updates RFC 7252 and RFC 8323 to extend the definition of the TKL field.

eli5.summary: Instead of remembering every request you sent, you write the notes on a longer name tag and it comes back with the reply.
